Name: Re-Skin Any to Any Weapon Type
Author: seqhilla
Description: You can't use a Sword skin on Club weapon nor dagger skin on sword etc. Forge don't let you reskin your weapon with other weapon types. But with this mod you can use any weapon to any weapon.

Downloads.Description: Any weapon to any weapon type with known bug of second skining using original skin.
